headline: Two-card retention (a Business Platinum upgrade, then a $50 credit after the customer declines a downgrade); the logic is sound and only cosmetic doc typos remain.

issues.summary: A required card document states a minimum credit score as a dollar amount. The value is cosmetic here: no gold argument depends on it and apply_for_credit_card takes no credit score.
issues.why_it_matters: No change to the correct final state. It is a corrupted value of the kind v1.0.1 cleaned elsewhere (e.g. "$120 days" in logistics_005) but left here.

issues.summary: The Business Platinum application doc states the minimum personal credit score as a dollar amount, and its title calls the card "Platinum Rewards Card", which is the name of the separate personal card. Both are cosmetic for this task.
evidence: doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_001 title: "Platinum Rewards Card: Elite Business Credit Card Application"
issues.why_it_matters: No change to the correct final state. The title could make an agent confuse the business and personal Platinum cards when it recommends one.
issues.suggested_fix: Change "$765" to "765" and retitle the doc "Business Platinum Rewards Card: ...".

solution_check: Silver Zoom (cc_c7d8e9f0a1_szoom): eligible ($0, no disputes or replacements), no closure history, reason found_better_card. The only business card beating 3.5% on travel/advertising with 0% foreign fee is Business Platinum (bp_002 4.0%, bp_008 FTF 0%, bp_011 first-year fee 0 during the 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28 promo), and the customer applies. Platinum (cc_c7d8e9f0a1_plat): $0, no history, reason annual_fee. Tenure is under 2 years on every relationship (checking 03/10/2024, Silver Zoom 03/15/2024, Platinum 06/20/2024), so the agent offers a Bronze downgrade (logistics_008) and the customer declines. Step 5 for premium-and-above is $50 or 5,000 points; the customer takes the $50 credit with reason retention_offer. This matches the gold and the replay is clean.
prior_note: Prior clean; still clean in substance, with newly reported Minor doc typos.
notes: The Platinum closure answer "The annual fee on that one is really bothering me. I don't use it as much as I used to." also names not_using_card. The customer's goal names only the annual fee, and the waiver/downgrade branch the script follows is the annual_fee branch, so I recorded residual risk, not a defect. Diamond Elite (5%, 0% FTF) is a personal, invitation-tier card and the customer asked for a business card, so Business Platinum is the unique fit.
